def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))

    # ---- Pre-aggregate payments (only payments known before seed_time) ----
    pay = db['payments']
    pay = pay[pay['ts'] < seed_time]
    order_payments = pay.groupby('order_id').agg(
        total_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        avg_payment_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        has_credit_card=('payment_type', lambda x: float(x.eq('credit_card').any())),
        has_boleto=('payment_type', lambda x: float(x.eq('boleto').any())),
    ).reset_index()

    # ---- Pre-aggregate reviews (only reviews created before seed_time) ----
    rev = db['reviews']
    rev = rev[rev['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    order_reviews = rev.groupby('order_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        num_reviews=('review_id', 'count'),
        share_positive=('review_score', lambda x: float((x >= 4).mean()) if len(x) else 0.0),
    ).reset_index()

    # ---- Orders known at seed_time (purchase happened before seed_time) ----
    orders = db['orders']
    orders = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]
    orders = orders[['order_id', 'order_status',
                     'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']]

    # ---- Relevant order items in the past ----
    items = db['order_items']
    relevant = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) & (items['ts'] < seed_time)].copy()

    if relevant.empty:
        features = base.copy()
        features['has_history'] = 0
        features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
        return features.astype(float)

    items_full = relevant.merge(orders, on='order_id', how='left') \
                         .merge(order_payments, on='order_id', how='left') \
                         .merge(order_reviews, on='order_id', how='left')

    items_full['days_before_seed'] = (seed_time - items_full['ts']).dt.days
    items_full['window'] = pd.cut(
        items_full['days_before_seed'],
        bins=[-1, 90, 180, 360, np.inf],
        labels=['w1', 'w2', 'w3', 'older']
    )

    # Success = delivered before seed_time (delivery date exists and is in the past).
    delivered_known = items_full['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                      (items_full['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)
    items_full['is_successful'] = delivered_known.astype(float)
    # Failed = canceled/unavailable status of an order placed before seed_time.
    items_full['is_failed'] = items_full['order_status'].isin(['canceled', 'unavailable']).astype(float)

    # Delivery delay only computable for orders delivered before seed_time.
    delay = (items_full['order_delivered_customer_date'] -
             items_full['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.days
    items_full['delivery_delay_days'] = delay.where(delivered_known)

    # Payment / review info is already time-filtered at source; mask rows
    # where the merge brought nothing.
    items_full['has_payment'] = items_full['total_payment'].notna().astype(float)
    items_full['has_review'] = items_full['num_reviews'].notna().astype(float)

    def agg_window(df, suffix):
        if df.empty:
            return pd.DataFrame(index=base.index)
        g = df.groupby('product_id')
        out = pd.DataFrame({
            f'units_sold_{suffix}': g.size(),
            f'num_orders_{suffix}': g['order_id'].nunique(),
            f'total_revenue_{suffix}': g['price'].sum(),
            f'total_freight_{suffix}': g['freight_value'].sum(),
            f'avg_price_{suffix}': g['price'].mean(),
            f'avg_freight_{suffix}': g['freight_value'].mean(),
            f'num_successful_orders_{suffix}':
                df.groupby('product_id').apply(
                    lambda d: d.loc[d['is_successful'] == 1, 'order_id'].nunique()),
            f'num_failed_orders_{suffix}':
                df.groupby('product_id').apply(
                    lambda d: d.loc[d['is_failed'] == 1, 'order_id'].nunique()),
            f'avg_delivery_delay_{suffix}': g['delivery_delay_days'].mean(),
            f'avg_total_payment_{suffix}':
                df[df['has_payment'] == 1].groupby('product_id')['total_payment'].mean(),
            f'avg_installments_{suffix}':
                df[df['has_payment'] == 1].groupby('product_id')['avg_payment_installments'].mean(),
            f'pct_credit_card_{suffix}':
                df[df['has_payment'] == 1].groupby('product_id')['has_credit_card'].mean(),
            f'pct_boleto_{suffix}':
                df[df['has_payment'] == 1].groupby('product_id')['has_boleto'].mean(),
            f'avg_review_score_{suffix}':
                df[df['has_review'] == 1].groupby('product_id')['avg_review_score'].mean(),
            f'num_reviews_{suffix}':
                df[df['has_review'] == 1].groupby('product_id')['num_reviews'].sum(),
            f'share_positive_reviews_{suffix}':
                df[df['has_review'] == 1].groupby('product_id')['share_positive'].mean(),
        })
        return out

    agg_w1 = agg_window(items_full[items_full['window'] == 'w1'], 'w1')
    agg_w2 = agg_window(items_full[items_full['window'] == 'w2'], 'w2')
    agg_w3 = agg_window(items_full[items_full['window'] == 'w3'], 'w3')
    agg_older = agg_window(items_full[items_full['window'] == 'older'], 'older')

    prod_history = items_full.groupby('product_id').agg(
        last_purchase_ts=('ts', 'max'),
        total_units_history=('price', 'size'),
        total_revenue_history=('price', 'sum'),
        avg_review_score_history=('avg_review_score', lambda x: x.dropna().mean()),
        total_reviews_history=('num_reviews', lambda x: x.dropna().sum()),
    )
    prod_history['days_since_last_purchase'] = (
        seed_time - prod_history['last_purchase_ts']).dt.days
    prod_history = prod_history.drop(columns=['last_purchase_ts'])

    features = base \
        .join(agg_w1, how='left') \
        .join(agg_w2, how='left') \
        .join(agg_w3, how='left') \
        .join(agg_older, how='left') \
        .join(prod_history, how='left')

    features['has_history'] = features['total_units_history'].notna().astype(int)

    numeric_cols = features.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
    features[numeric_cols] = features[numeric_cols].fillna(0)
    features.loc[features['has_history'] == 0, 'days_since_last_purchase'] = 9999

    eps = 1e-6
    features['units_growth_w1_w2'] = (features['units_sold_w1'] - features['units_sold_w2']) / (features['units_sold_w2'] + eps)
    features['revenue_growth_w1_w2'] = (features['total_revenue_w1'] - features['total_revenue_w2']) / (features['total_revenue_w2'] + eps)
    features['units_growth_w2_w3'] = (features['units_sold_w2'] - features['units_sold_w3']) / (features['units_sold_w3'] + eps)
    features['aov_w1'] = features['total_revenue_w1'] / (features['num_orders_w1'] + eps)
    features['aov_w2'] = features['total_revenue_w2'] / (features['num_orders_w2'] + eps)
    features['aov_w3'] = features['total_revenue_w3'] / (features['num_orders_w3'] + eps)
    features['freight_ratio_w1'] = features['total_freight_w1'] / (features['total_revenue_w1'] + eps)
    features['freight_ratio_w2'] = features['total_freight_w2'] / (features['total_revenue_w2'] + eps)
    features['success_rate_w1'] = features['num_successful_orders_w1'] / (features['num_orders_w1'] + eps)
    features['success_rate_w2'] = features['num_successful_orders_w2'] / (features['num_orders_w2'] + eps)

    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    return features
